finding: The Cashbook is wrong in three ways. (1) The page sends `from`/`to`, but the API reads `from_date`/`to_date`, so the date filter is ignored: the filter says 08/31–09/30 yet rows from 2026-07-05 are listed. (2) The API caps lists at 100 rows, so "100 transactions" is the cap, not the count, even though the page asks for `limit=500`. (3) The running balance starts at R0 with no opening balance, so it ends at R100 849 against an account whose ledger is -R1.57m. The totals are totals of an arbitrary 100 rows.
rec: Use `from_date`/`to_date`, a dedicated unpaged cashbook endpoint, and a server-computed opening balance as at `from`.

finding: The reconciliation workspace loads bank lines with `limit=500`, which the server caps at 100, and GL lines with `limit=200`. The Brightsphere in-progress reconciliation shows "Bank Transactions (100 unmatched)", but 8 089 lines belong to it (DB count). An accountant would reconcile against a silently truncated list.
rec: Paginate or virtualise, and show true counts from the server. Never present a capped list as the population.

finding: The widget labelled **GL Balance** shows `bank.balance` = `SUM(bank_transactions.amount)`, which is the statement-line total, not the ledger. For Demo 1110 it shows R 36 155 670,71, but posted GL for 1110 is -R 1 573 572,60 (DB) and the Bank Transactions report shows a closing of -R 694 249,48. The widget's statement-vs-GL "difference" is computed from this wrong figure. Bank Accounts shows the same value as "Net Balance".
rec: Show two labelled figures, "Statement balance" and "Ledger balance", from the right sources, plus the gap between them. Rename "Net Balance" on the account cards.

finding: "Unallocated 718" counts every row with no journal link and no suggestion, whatever its status. That includes 530 `reconciled` and 75 `matched` rows. The real queue of imported rows with no suggestion is about 114. Several code paths set `status='matched'` without `matched_journal_line_id` (captureBankTxAttachService.ts:58, evidenceAttachmentService.ts:122, ai-invoice-pipeline.ts:150), so this also affects production. The four counters (3 / 292 / 718 / 408) do not reconcile to anything on screen.
evidence: accounting_bank_transactions.png; bankAccountStatusService.ts:93-110; DB status breakdown (imported 405 / reconciled 530 / matched 75 / allocated 3)
rec: Scope the counters to the work queue (`status IN ('imported','allocated')`). Make each counter a filter link that produces exactly that many rows.

finding: The Bank account `<select>` has 4 options with **empty labels**: the page renders `a.name`, but the API returns `accountName`. The user cannot tell which account a statement will be imported into, and the first account is silently preselected.

finding: Reviewed (`matched`) rows show only the word "Allocated" in Selection. The component falls back to that when no journal account resolves, so the screen cannot answer "where did this go?". No cell links to the journal, invoice or payment.

finding: Tab, page number, filters and search are all React state; the URL stays `/accounting/bank-transactions`. Reloading page 2 returns to page 1. Back after drilling out loses the tab. You cannot share or bookmark "Reviewed, account X, June".
evidence: banking-tx.mjs log (URL unchanged on page 2, "after reload Displaying 1–25"); pages/accounting/bank-transactions/index.tsx:67-80

finding: The top nav highlights **Dashboard**, not Banking. The resolver only matches `/accounting/bank-`, so `/accounting/bank/…`, cashbook and netcash fall through to the `dashboard` default.

finding: The grid keeps desktop columns. Selection, VAT, amounts and actions are cut off to the right inside a clipped container. The counters are cut off ("Su…"). The filter bar takes about 5 rows. You cannot code a transaction on a phone.

finding: For an unbalanced reconciliation (Difference R 50 000, GL R 0,00, "No unmatched GL lines") the only next steps are "Auto-Match" and "Cancel Reconciliation". finding: There are two separate statement-import products. Import Statement (`/bank-reconciliation/import`) is bulk: PDF, CSV, OFX, QIF and MT940. Statement Imports (`/bank/statements` → `import-pdf`) is PDF only, 10 MB, with a different layout and accent colour (indigo). Both appear in the Banking flyout.

finding: For a -R 101,00 spend dated 2026-08-28, every candidate is a R 115,00 supplier invoice dated a month **later** (2026-09-2x). Scores are shown as "28pt" with no explanation. finding: The Refresh button is labelled **"Actions"** (RefreshCw icon, title="Refresh"). "Mark as Reviewed" and "Batch Allocate" are two different bulk verbs, and the second only appears after you select rows. The CC and BU toggles are unexplained two-letter buttons.

finding: The bulk "Delete" of imported bank lines sits next to the everyday actions and is guarded only by `window.confirm`.

finding: On a row near the bottom of the viewport the dropdown opens upward and is clipped behind the header: only "+ New Account" is visible. It lists header/group accounts (1000 Assets, 1100 Current Assets) as pickable.

finding: The widget floats in the middle of the header with a large empty area to its left. Opening and Closing show "—" beside an "MT940" badge and "1 transactions · Imported 30 Sept 2026", so it describes the latest single import rather than the account.

finding: The rule list has exact duplicates (EFT PMT BIDVEST CLEANING ×2, CITY OF JHB ×2, FROGFOOT ×2, VELOCITYFIBRE ×2). finding: No banking page renders a breadcrumb (`breadcrumb: null` in every capture). finding: An unknown or foreign account id silently shows the first account, with no notice.

finding: Every load and every account switch POSTs `/api/accounting/bank-relink-transfers`, a write triggered by viewing the page. Separately, `saveSelection` on type/entity change reports failure only on network errors: `apiFetch` resolves on 4xx, so a rejected save is silent.

finding: The default "from" date is computed with `toISOString()` on local midnight. In SAST (UTC+2) the 1st of the month becomes the last day of the previous month (shows 08/31/2026).

finding: The flyout is a cascade: Lists ▸ (one item: Bank Accounts), Transactions ▸, Special ▸, Netcash ▸. Every destination takes a hover plus a click. "Special" is not a meaningful group, and "Mapping Rules" and "Categorisation Rules" name the same page.

finding: The queue is feature-rich but manual: 408 rows, 25 per page, each one clicked. 292 rows already carry a suggestion, but there is no one-click "Accept all high-confidence (n)" and no exceptions-first ordering. rec: Split the queue into "Auto-approved ≥85% (review sample)", "Suggested — confirm", and "Unknown — code or ask client". Accept a whole section with one keystroke and undo it with another.

finding: There is no detail pane. Notes, attachments, queries, rule history and the resulting journal are split across 7 icon modals.

finding: Pages use 3 header patterns plus ad-hoc ones. `<PageHeader>` is used by **18** pages. **319** AppLayout pages hand-roll an `<h1>`: the "ff header band" (`border-b … bg-[var(--ff-bg-secondary)] px-6 py-4`) in **98** pages, the dark gradient hero (`from-slate-900 via-slate-800`) in **22**, and the rest are one-offs. finding: The design-system primitives are mostly unused. `<Button>`: 42 uses vs **1,574** raw `<button>` (124 files hand-code `bg-teal-600`). `ui/Modal`: 4 files vs **76** hand-rolled `fixed inset-0` overlays. evidence: `src/components/ui/index.ts`; `pages/_app.tsx:4,111`; `pages/accounting/customers/[customerId].tsx:131`; `pages/payroll/runs/[id].tsx:127`; counts from `grep` (commands in the session log).

finding: There are at least 6 shared money helpers (`utils/formatters.formatCurrency` in 81 files, `lib/money/formatMoney`, `lib/format/money.formatMoney`, `<Money>` in 3 files, `loans/types.fmt`, `capture/fmtZAR`) plus **140 local `fmt`/`fmtZAR`/`fmtCurrency` definitions** (91 are `const fmt =`), **131** inline `new Intl.NumberFormat`, **85** `.toFixed(` and **26** `toLocaleString()` calls with no locale. Worst pages: `/accounting/sars/vat201` (7 local fmts, 11 toFixed), `/accounting` (6/9), `/accounting/bank-transactions` (5/5), `/accounting/sars/emp201` (9 toFixed).
rec: One `formatMoney` (R, thousands separator, negatives in brackets or minus, decided once) and one `formatDate` (dd MMM yyyy, en-ZA). Codemod the local `fmt`s.

finding: Every page header shows a comfortable/compact density toggle, but only 2 components read it (`TrialBalanceRow`, `AuditLogTable`). The other 290 files with raw `<table>` ignore it, so on most pages the control does nothing.

finding: **250** pages under AppLayout wrap their content in `min-h-screen`, inside a main area that is already `h-screen` and scrolls (`AppLayout.tsx:314,485-490`). route: Dead nav code and legacy paths

finding: These agent tools have no in-app equivalent: `list_agent_postings` (what unattended agents posted), `propose_reclassification` / `post_reclassification_batch`, `data_integrity_checks`, `chart_of_accounts_health`, `reconcile_subledger` (AR/AP vs GL), `reconcile_fixed_assets`, `merge_gl_accounts`. finding: The AI that is exposed is buried in inconsistent places. The Close agent appears only on the Month-End workbench (`CloseAgentPanel`). rec: Create one "Inbox / To-do" home (the bureau cockpit is the natural host) that mixes human to-dos with AI suggestions (categorisations, matches, anomalies, missing invoices, expected bills) and a one-click next action on each row.

finding: See the table below: about 15 groups of pages do the same job. Four of them are backed by **different tables or services**: products vs items, `supplier_purchase_orders` vs `purchase_orders`, `company-groups` vs `consolidation`, and the two time-entry services. That is a correctness risk, not just clutter.
rec: Consolidate in the order given in "Top 5" below.

finding: **No way to approve a calculated run from the UI.** The header has Variance / Cost centres / Cash register / Recalculate only. `POST /api/payroll/runs/[id]/approve` exists but no page calls it (grep: no caller under `pages/` or `src/components`). The page even says "payroll can still be approved and paid", yet there is no button for it. Approval (and so the GL journal and EMP201 declarability) is reachable only via MCP/API.
rec: Add a primary "Review & approve" action on calculated runs with a confirmation that summarises the totals, the warnings and the journal it will post. After approval show next steps: payslips → bank file → EMP201.

route: Payroll › Reports › Year-End Workflow; Tax › SARS Submissions › Year-End Workflow
finding: `/payroll/year-end` is **redirected to `/accounting/year-end`**, the GL fiscal-year close ("irreversible… zeros revenue and expense accounts", with live "Process Year-End" buttons). The real guided payroll year-end page (`pages/payroll/year-end/index.tsx`, IRP5/EMP501/lockdown checklist) can't be reached.
rec: Remove the redirect (added in dc147ddeb). Label the GL page "Financial year-end close" so the two are never confused.

finding: IRP5 Readiness flags the standard SARS codes 3601, 3605, 4001, 4005 and 4006 as "unknown SARS source code for tax year 2027". It shows **0 of 10 certificates ready** for the current tax year (Mar 2026–Feb 2027), with 60+ red chips. Cause: the lookup is strict on `effective_year = taxYear`, and `sars_source_codes` has only 2024/2025/2026 rows in dev (current release = 2026). I checked dev only, not prod.
rec: Fall back to the current release when a year isn't loaded. Show one banner ("SARS code table for 2027 not loaded") instead of blaming every component and employee. Check prod has 2027 codes.

finding: Shows "All periods reconcile — **ready to submit EMP501**". The "EMP201 PAYE" column is actually `payroll_run_headers.total_paye`, compared with the sum of that same run's lines. That is a self-consistency check, not EMP201-as-declared vs IRP5 vs the GL PAYE control account. It also contradicts IRP5 (0 ready) on the same tax year.
rec: Reconcile against the filed EMP201 amounts and the PAYE control account balance. Gate "ready to submit" on IRP5 readiness too. Flag to the tax owner.

finding: **No payslips exist.** Run line rows aren't clickable, there's no payslip view/PDF/email, and there's no per-employee YTD. The brief's "list → run → payslips" flow can't be done.
rec: Click a line to open a payslip drawer (earnings, deductions, employer contributions, YTD, leave). Add a bulk PDF/print for the run.

finding: Numbers don't explain themselves. For Riaan, Gross R75,000 − PAYE R19,966.33 − UIF R177.12 = R54,856.55, but Net shows R41,681.55. The R13,175 of medical/provident/RA deductions isn't shown anywhere on the run. "Total UIF" (R3,249.68) silently combines employee and employer UIF. No totals row.
rec: Add Other deductions and Employer contributions columns plus a totals footer. Split the UIF cards. Hovering Net should show the waterfall.

finding: Warning deep links (`#date-of-birth`, `#tax-number`, `#bank-details`) point to anchors that **don't exist**: the employee page has no element ids, so you land at the top. Bank details can't be captured anywhere in the UI, yet the engine warns "EFT payment will fail" and links to `#bank-details`. DOB is "missing" for all 10 staff even though every SA ID number encodes it; typing an ID on New Employee doesn't fill DOB.
evidence: `flow/04-deeplink-landing.png` (hasAnchor=0); `validationEngine.ts:46,56,119`; employee form has no bank fields (`pages/payroll/employees/new.tsx:116-167`)
rec: Add field ids and scroll/focus. Add a Bank details section. Derive DOB (and gender/citizenship) from the ID number, with a one-click fix for all 10 from the warning panel.

finding: The 11 warnings are near-identical lines, and the comment claims de-duplication, but the messages include names so nothing merges. One warning ("taxable income above the annual threshold but zero PAYE") **doesn't say which employee**.
rec: Group by code ("ETI: DOB missing for 10 employees — fix all"). Always name the employee.

finding: The "Employees" headcount card is formatted as currency: **"R 10,00"**, "prior R 10,00". Jan 2031 is compared with Dec 2026 (a 4-year gap) with no warning.
rec: Render counts as integers. Warn when the prior run isn't the previous month.

finding: Clicking these payroll menu items **switches the sub-nav to TAX** (VAT/SARS Submissions/Compliance/Settings) while the payroll period bar stays. There's no way back to Payroll except through the Library. EMP201 isn't in the payroll menu at all: it lives at `/accounting/sars/emp201` under Tax only.
rec: Keep one Payroll context for everything payroll-statutory (including EMP201), or show both breadcrumbs.

finding: "Current period" is just the highest `period_year/month` run, so ISAFlow Demo's bar says **Jan 2031 · Calculated** on every payroll page. The badge map has `posted` (not a real status) and no `paid`, so a paid run would show "No run yet". Period N of 12 uses `companies.financial_year_start`, not the SA tax year (March).
rec: Base "current" on the first unapproved period ≤ today. Fix the status map. Anchor to the March tax year.

finding: Month/year default to today's month (Sep 2026) even though Sep–Dec 2026 are already approved. Year is a free number input (2020–2099), which is how a Jan 2031 run exists. There's no "next period" suggestion and no check for employees before creating a run (Brightsphere has 0 employees but the empty state offers "New Payroll Run").
rec: Default to the next open period, block far-future periods, and make the empty state a setup checklist (company PAYE/UIF/SDL refs → components → employees → first run).

finding: The bureau work aggregator treats `approved` as pending (`status IN ('draft','calculated','approved')`). Nothing in the codebase ever sets a run to `paid`. So **every approved run would sit on the bureau board forever as "Pay run · approved"** and turn overdue after month-end + 1. I couldn't verify in the browser (QA user isn't in a bureau). There's also no per-client payroll status board: just mixed work items (pay run, IRP5 readiness, directives, leave).
rec: Drop `approved` from pending, or add a Mark paid/bank-file step. Build a client × month payroll grid (not started/calculated/approved/paid/EMP201 filed).

finding: A non-member sees only "You aren't a member of any bureau." with no h1 and no way to create or join one. The Dashboard tab is highlighted. `/bureau` silently redirects non-members to /accounting.
rec: Explain bureau mode and offer "Create practice / request invite". Highlight Portfolio, not Dashboard.

finding: Date off-by-one in SAST. Day cells are keyed by `toISOString()` of local-midnight dates, so every cell carries the previous day's ISO. The "today" highlight lands on **Thu 01 Oct** when today is Wed 30 Sep, and week fetch/entry prefill are shifted a day. This is billable time, not payroll: time entries don't feed any pay run.
rec: Use a local-date formatter. Separately, decide whether hourly employees' time should flow into pay runs (Batch Transactions).

finding: Tables clip instead of adapting: Start/Status/View columns cut off on employees; run header actions (Cost centres, Cash register, Recalculate) run off-screen; stat cards truncate "R 334 000,0". `overflowX` reports false only because inner containers clip.

finding: The empty state says "Mark an employee's payment method as 'cash' on their detail page", but there is no payment-method field on the employee page.

finding: Variance and Cost Centre use the standard header with an arrow. Cash Register uses a narrow centred container with a "Back to run" text link. Cost Centre and Cash Register headers don't say which run/period they show. All back targets correctly go to the run (verified); browser Back works.

finding: 3 requests from Mar–Apr 2026 are still **Pending** 5+ months later with no ageing, sort or highlight. The list mixes statuses in name order. No inline or bulk approve. The detail page shows no remaining balance and no clash with the pay run, and the employee name isn't a link. The new-leave form shows business days (good) but not the available balance.

finding: The "360°" view is a stack of 8 edit forms at ~57% width, each with its own Save. rec: Put a summary header on top (status, package, YTD, leave, alerts) with tabs: Pay · Leave · Loans · Tax · Documents · History. Collapse termination behind an action.

finding: `<label>` elements have no `htmlFor`/nesting, so fields have no accessible names. Required-field validation relies only on native browser bubbles. Dates render mm/dd/yyyy (browser locale) while tables use ISO.

finding: Run status is lowercase ("calculated", "approved") on list and detail but title-case in the period bar. Leave/employee chips are title-case.

finding: There is no payroll home: `/payroll` redirects to the employee list.
rec: A "This month's payroll" cockpit: a stepper (inputs → calculate → review variances → approve → payslips → bank file → EMP201 by the 7th) with exceptions first (missing DOB/bank, new hires, terminations, pending leave, expiring directives) and one-click fixes.

finding: **No fee or engagement pricing tool.** Client `billing_model` (hourly/fixed/retainer), job `billing_type`, `fixed_fee_amount` and `budgeted_hours` are stored and shown. rec: Add a Practice home and a client 360 page with Jobs / Tasks / Time / WIP / Invoices / Deadlines tabs.

rec: Add `linked_company_id` to practice clients. Show "Open books" on the client and "Practice" columns (WIP, jobs, next deadline) in Portfolio.

finding: **A new client disappears.** The form defaults Status to Prospect, the list defaults to the Active filter, and the Jobs/Time pickers load `status=active` only. rec: Default to Active (or ask), and default the list to "All". Let jobs/time accept Onboarding clients, or explain why a client is missing.

finding: **Time can never be booked to a job.** The Time Entry form has no Job field, and no insert writes `time_entries.job_id` (UI or MCP). The job's "Time" tab (`?jobId=`) is always empty, and budget vs actual and fixed-fee recovery are impossible.
rec: Add an optional Job picker filtered by client; show hours vs budget on the job.

finding: **Three time-capture screens, two data models.** Practice › Time Entry is day-only (client/category/work item; staff rate). `/accounting/timesheets` is a week grid of Customer/Project with a manual "Rate (ZAR/hr)". `/accounting/time-tracking` is a list with the same model. There is no timer anywhere and no weekly grid for practice time.
rec: Use one time model. Make the week grid practice-aware and add a running timer. Retire or redirect the legacy two.

finding: "View invoice" after generating a WIP invoice links to `/accounting/customer-invoices?id=<id>`. The list page never reads `id`, so it opens the generic "Tax Invoices" list, not the new draft. Global search uses the same broken URL.

finding: **Two reports are misdescribed.** "Compliance Report — deadline tracking across client engagements, flag overdue filings" actually measures staff timesheet submission days. "Revenue Pipeline — forecast from active jobs and quoted work, by month and by client" is approved WIP × a hard-coded 0.8, with no jobs, quotes, months or clients.
rec: Rename to "Timesheet compliance" and "WIP forecast", or build the described reports (SARS deadlines; job/fee pipeline).

finding: Revenue counts only `time_entries.status='billed'`. Fixed-fee or retainer work invoiced normally shows R0 revenue with the full time cost, so the margin is negative. finding: There are no SARS or statutory deadlines per client (VAT201/EMP201/provisional/ITR14/CIPC). Tasks are free-form with a single due date. The recurring-task backend (`tasks/recurring` API + cron) has no UI to make a task recurring.

finding: Headers and layout vary. Most pages use a full-width teal header card, Staff Rates and Reports index use a centered narrow layout, and Timesheets/Time Tracking use a blue primary and a different header.
